verdict.rationale: Updates happen only when a user explicitly runs `yy skills install` or `yy skills update`, which selects the latest compatible stable release (yylo-skills-gh-6). Customized or unrecorded copies are flagged for review rather than silently overwritten or deleted (yylo-skills-docs-3). Skills are independently versioned, and plugin version parity is validated (yylo-skills-docs-19, yylo-skills-docs-20, yylo-skills-gh-7), so changes do not land silently. missing for 10: pinning to a specific version rather than the latest compatible release, a committed team-shared lockfile or manifest, a documented way to roll out updates across a team, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
